# Introduction

{{"template":"referral","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a concept introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / lcc:0.3.2"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_stars:0.1.0"}}. It is produced by {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/generator","plural":true}}, converted into steam by {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler","plural":true}}, and finally converted into {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}} by {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:turbine","plural":true}}.

Heat can be transferred from {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/generator","plural":true}} to {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler","plural":true}} directly upwards, or through {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:heat_pipe","plural":true}}.
